title: Building a Personal Blog in Go
content:
A personal blog is an excellent project for learning backend development.

This project demonstrates how to:

- Read and write JSON files
- Render HTML templates
- Build CRUD operations
- Parse forms
- Serve static assets
- Organize Go packages

Instead of using a database, articles are stored inside a JSON file, making the project easier to understand while still covering real-world concepts.

Future improvements include authentication, Markdown support, pagination, search, syntax highlighting, and image uploads.
